description:
A schematic map illustrating the typical spatial arrangement of land cover types in a coastal lagoon landscape. The map uses four distinct colours, each corresponding to a specific land cover class identified with a CORINE Land Cover (CLC) nomenclature code and a descriptive label.

The legend on the right provides the following colour-code mapping:
*   Light blue represents "Coastal lagoon".
*   Yellow represents "Sand bank".
*   Light green represents "Irrigated land".
*   Dark blue represents "Sea and Ocean".

The map shows a light green area labelled "2.1.1 Arable irrigated and non-irrigated land" bordering a large body of light blue water labelled "8.3.1 Lagoons". The lagoon is separated from the dark blue water, labelled "8.4.2 Coastal waters" (Sea and Ocean), by elongated yellow landforms labelled "6.2.1. Beaches and Dunes" (Sand bank). This schematic demonstrates the typical transition of land cover from agricultural land to lagoons, then across sand barriers to the open sea.
